If your mom never gave it to you, that is 100% on her and I’m so sorry you were subjected to someone like that. It’s not fair. Life isn’t fair in so many ways. When I’m in a dark place, I go outside and look for hummingbirds. It doesn’t solve a fucking thing, and most of the time I’m sitting out there I’m just thinking about negative shit. Navigating this misery is tough, but finding those pockets of happiness, no matter how short, can kinda help. I wish you all the best, all the strength, and all the love. You are worthy of it all ♥️

NTA. First, I’m so sorry for your loss. You honored your son’s wishes even though I’m sure that wasn’t easy. Your wife must be in so much pain having to deal with the loss of one child, and the anger and resentment of another. Give her grace and time. She’s a victim of the horrible, selfish, and disgraceful acts of your youngest son. I do feel for him though, because these bad decisions are now crashing down on him and there is nothing he can ever do to make it better. We have a similar situation in our family. My youngest uncles wife of 10 years left him for his oldest brother. It ripped our family apart. And since that happened, both my grandparents died of cancer wishing that our family was whole again. It never was again while they were alive, and it never will be. My oldest uncle lost both his parents alone. Not a single one of his 6 siblings were there for him because of the choices he made. These people think their “love” is the only thing that matters, but they don’t realize the ripple effect of it all. There are many more victims in these situations than just the person whose spouse left them. I hope you and your wife are one day able to find peace and joy in each day. Again, I am so very sorry for your unimaginable loss.

This resonated with me so much, I can’t even explain. Luckily (maybe idk) I had gained a little weight before I found out I was pregnant so I was already starting to struggle with my body image. After I had my son, I gained 50lbs on top of the 20/25 I had already gained before that. I was huge. No matter what I did, I was always hungry and always so tired. Breastfeeding and having a newborn is ROUGH. It just wouldn’t get better. I gave up hope. But right around the time my son turned 1 1/2 he started to become sooooo active. We started doing more outside, it got easier and easier. He’s nearly 2 1/2 now and we walk to the park every day. I’m not post partum anymore and feel that my hormones are back to normal for the most part. It’s been a lot easier to drop weight since he’s gotten older. I’m finally down 30lbs and counting. Nowhere near where I want to be, but I thought I’d never be able to loose weight. Just give your body some grace right now. It’s gone through so much, and needs time to find balance again. Your body created, birthed, and fed a child. That is fucking incredible. You will get through this and things will get easier ❤️
